wordmark.purpose: The ChartDown name beside the red spike X.

headline-marker.purpose: The tagline, written on a tape strip.

title-marker.purpose: Song title on the sheet; readout values.

chord.purpose: Chord numbers and letters on the sheet and transposition strips. Never Marker.

note-marker.purpose: MD notes, stage-plot notes, syntax glosses.

lede.purpose: Hero sentence on the floor, max 30ch.

body.purpose: Paragraph copy on the floor, max 62ch.

label-caps.purpose: Readout labels, section badges, who-tags, stage-plot names, fact keys.

cue.purpose: Text in cue chips, always including the player's name.

source.purpose: Machine text only: .chartdown source, commands, JSON, inline syntax.

shadows.name: tape-on-floor
shadows.purpose: filter on every tape strip wrapper; follows the torn mask.

shadows.name: sheet-on-floor
shadows.purpose: filter on the hero set list sheet.

shadows.name: paper-on-floor
shadows.purpose: filter on the syntax road-case paper and JSON card (JSON uses 18px 22px).

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: The single easing curve for every transition and animation.

motion.name: lay
motion.value: 0.5s clip-path inset(0 100% 0 0) to inset(0) + translateX(-6px) to 0
motion.purpose: Tape laid down: the one authored entrance, on cues and notes revealed by a spike-mark change.

motion.name: draw
motion.purpose: Marker ring drawn around the pressed spike mark or key.

motion.name: flip
motion.purpose: Chord glyphs re-written in place on a key change.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Hover and press state transitions on tabs, keys, actions.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion removes all motion and smooth scroll.

breakpoints.name: stack
breakpoints.purpose: Hero and builders collapse to one column; stage plot becomes a grid.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: Header stacks, sheet loses skew, lyrics hide, actions move above the sheet.

materials.name: torn-tape-mask
materials.value: SVG torn-edge masks on left and right ends (9px tape, 6px nav tabs, 7px gaff) plus a center fill
materials.purpose: Gives every tape piece torn ends.

materials.name: noise
materials.purpose: Multiplied into tape and paper, screened into dark tape and gaff.

materials.name: scuff
materials.value: feTurbulence fractalNoise, baseFrequency .004 .03, opacity .07, fixed full-viewport
materials.purpose: Painted stage-floor wear on the page ground.

materials.name: light-pool
materials.purpose: Soft overhead light on the floor.

materials.name: rotation
materials.value: tape -1.6deg to 1.3deg; sheet .7deg; road case -.4deg; gaff 32 to 38deg
materials.purpose: Everything is laid down by hand.

narrative.overview:
The page is a scuffed, charcoal-painted stage at soundcheck. The chart is a set list taped down at the players' feet; every block of copy that needs to be found fast is written on a strip of torn off-white gaffer tape; chord numbers and MD notes are written in by hand; headlines are road-case stencil. Each player's position is marked with a colored spike-tape X, and those five colors are the only saturated hues in the world.

It is a dark, low-light, material world. Depth comes from physical things lying on a floor (tape, paper, gaff corners) with real drop shadows and slight skew, never from floating cards or glass. Long reading copy sits directly on the floor in chalk, for comfort; tape is reserved for labels, headlines, commands and the primary action. The chart sheet is the hero object and is live: real ChartDown text rendered by the reference parser, re-taped when the player or key changes.

The world rejects the open-source split hero (code left, render right, feature cards below). It also explicitly stands apart from `playground/index.html`, which is an older light-themed reference tool and is not governed by this file.
keyCharacteristics: Charcoal floor ground with a fractal "scuff" texture and a soft top-right pool of light.
Torn-edge tape strips (CSS mask with jagged left/right ends) carrying headlines, labels and the primary action.
Paper sheets held down by four rotated black gaff corners.
Five spike-tape role colors, always paired with a label and the X mark, never color alone.
Four hand-feel faces with strict jobs: stencil caps, marker, condensed numerals, plain sans; mono only for machine text.
Small rotations (between -1.6deg and 1.3deg) on tape and paper; nothing is perfectly square except the controls' hit areas.

rules.name: The One Player, One Color Rule
rules.body: Each spike color means one player and nothing else. Never use drums red for "danger", keys blue for "link", or green for "success"; the only allowed borrowings are the yellow action role and the red wordmark X, both already in the build.

rules.name: The Mark And Label Rule
rules.body: A role color never appears alone. Every spike color is accompanied by the X mark and the player's name (spike buttons, stage-plot positions), or by the name written into the chip ("Drums: in").

rules.name: The Floor Is Not A Palette Rule
rules.body: No new background hues. Surfaces are floor, raised floor, tape, paper or gaff.

rules.name: The Numbers Are Not Handwriting Rule
rules.body: Chord numbers are always set in Shoulders 900, never in Marker: Marker's numeral 1 reads as a bracket at chart size, and the numbers are the most-read glyphs on the page.

rules.name: The Mono Is Machine Text Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono appears only for literal text a machine reads: `.chartdown` source, shell commands, JSON and inline syntax. Never for labels, headings or decoration.

rules.name: The Read It On The Floor Rule
rules.body: Paragraph copy (lede, subcopy, facts) sits on the floor in Archivo. Marker and tape are for short, glanceable writing.

rules.name: The Lying Flat Rule
rules.body: Every raised object is something that could physically lie on a stage. If it would not be taped down, it does not get a shadow.

dos: **Do** put every short, glanceable label, headline-on-tape and the primary action on a torn tape strip with the tape-on-floor shadow and a rotation under 2deg.
**Do** pair every spike color with the X mark and the player's name.
**Do** set chord numbers in Shoulders 900 and MD notes in Marker.
**Do** render real ChartDown text through the reference parser wherever a chart is shown.
**Do** keep long copy on the floor in Archivo at 62ch or narrower.
**Do** use the shared ease (`cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)`) and let the tape-laying reveal (0.5s clip from the left) be the one authored entrance; everything else is a state transition under 0.4s.
**Do** honor `prefers-reduced-motion` by removing all animation and transition.
**Do** use the bass-yellow 3px focus ring with 3px offset on the floor; inset it on tape and tabs.
**Do** give English and Spanish identical layout and weight.
donts: **Don't** use a role color for status, links or decoration unrelated to that player.
**Don't** use mono for anything a machine does not read.
**Don't** put paragraphs on tape, or make the source field look like tape.
**Don't** add floating cards, glass, gradients-as-surfaces or new background hues; surfaces are floor, raised floor, tape, paper and gaff.
**Don't** square up the world: a page of perfectly aligned, unrotated tape reads as a template, not a stage.
**Don't** style the separate `playground/index.html` reference tool from this file.
